Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for Sri Lanka's reply! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Dimuth Karunaratne and Oshada Fernando are the openers for Sri Lanka. Khaled Ahmed has the new ball and is raring to go. Let's play...
... SECOND INNINGS ...

Now, the visitors will have to put all that behind and concentrate on their batting! The wicket is a good one to bat on but one needs to apply themselves. Bangladesh on the other hand, will look for early wickets and make use of the new ball as later on, batting will probably get easier. Stay tuned for Lanka's reply.

The Sri Lankan spinners disappointed yet again! None of them got a wicket and the economy was also on the higher side. The pacers were outstanding. Kasun Rajitha and Asitha Fernando bowled their hearts out and the two picked 9 wickets between them. The visitors will be very disappointed they have let the hosts off the hook completely. Had the two pacers gotten support, the story could have been a lot more different.

The Bangladesh innings has finally come to an end and who thought they would end up with something over 350? They looked down and out at 25 for 5 after electing to bat on Day 1 but then came the fightback. A partnership that will be remembered for very long. A 272-run stand between Litton Das and Mushfiqur Rahim not only took the hosts out of trouble but also have taken them into ascendancy in this game. Both scored tons, Das fell early this morning, Hossain followed too and at that stage, it seemed Bangladesh will finish below the 350-run mark. Rahim though played brilliantly with the tail and has taken his side over that score and into a very, very strong position in this game.

The decision is sent upstairs and the replay shows that Hossain did put in the desperate dive but his bat is on the line as the bails come off. Hossain goes and Rahim stays not out on 175 as Bangladesh get bundled out for 365!

We are back for the post-Lunch session on Day 2! The umpires and the Sri Lankan players are out on the field. Mushfiqur Rahim and Ebadot Hossain to resume their innings. Praveen Jayawickrama to start with the ball after the interval.
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

Right then, with the hosts extending their first-innings total to over 350, the upcoming session becomes really crucial for both teams as either of them could sort of edge ahead in the match depending on what happens. Do join us for the post-Lunch session soon.

The visitors will be happy with most of the session but will be highly disappointed with the fact that they haven't been able to bundle out the opposition in this session. Kasun Rajitha kept on impressing as he used his line and length to get rid of Litton Das and then made it a fi-fer as well. The Sri Lankan spinners continued to struggle and their wait for a first wicket in this Test match continues. Asitha Fernando bowled his heart out on a hot morning and was finally able to pick up a couple of wickets with the short ball. The visitors will have to come out once again in the sun but with one wicket remaining, they will look to get the job done at the earliest.

When Bangladesh came out to bat this morning, their first target would have been to get the score to 350 and they have achieved that with ease. When Litton Das departed for a brilliantly-made 141 early in the session and Mosaddek Hossain following suit, the hosts seemed to be getting bundled out for around 300. It was then Mushfiqur Rahim who took matters into his own hands and Taijul Islam gave him ample support as they added 49 crucial runs. A couple of more wickets fell but Rahim stood strong like a rock and remains unbeaten on 171.
Fuller and outside off, Ebadot Hossain block it towards gully. That will be Lunch for Day 2.

Session summary - 28 overs/84 runs/4 wickets. An engrossing session of Test cricket comes to an end and even though Sri Lanka made inroads, the session has been edged by the hosts thanks to some superb batting by Mushfiqur Rahim.

We are ready for play on Day 2! The overnight batters for Bangladesh, Mushfiqur Rahim and Litton Das to resume their innings. Asitha Fernando to start proceedings with the ball for Sri Lanka.

PITCH REPORT - Roshan Abeysinghe says there was help for the pacers early on Day 1 but with the sun coming out it has dried up. There is some grass today as well but the pitch is drying up and over the next couple of days, the spinners will come more and more into the game. The key is to use the crease to the spinners.

We witnessed a recovery of all sorts from Bangladesh as they ended Day 1 on 277 for 5 after reeling at 24 for 5 in the first session. Tons from Rahim and Das has put the hosts in a decent position in this game. 400 is what they’ll be eyeing, Sri Lanka on the other hand will know a few wickets early and they are right back into the contest. The first session could prove to be an important one. Welcome to the coverage of Day 2.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

Sri Lanka on the other hand, need to break this stand as quickly as possible. The second new ball is still just the 5 overs old and they’ll be fresh on the morning of Day 2 and will hope to make most of it. The first session will be a very important one. Do join us for all the action which will begin at 0930 IST (1000 local). The build up though will begin a lot earlier. Till then, goodbye and take care.

The day though began brilliantly for the Lankans as they had Bangladesh reeling at 24 for 5. Rajitha and Fernando wrecked havoc as they ran through the top order in no time. Since then though, it has been all Bangladesh. Rahim and Das weathered the storm and as the day went on, batting got easier. Sri Lanka did get the opportunity to break the stand but could not grab onto it as Das was dropped. That is costing them dearly as the two have added well over 200 and have crossed their tons and are yet not done. Bangladesh will hope for more of the same.

What a day of Test cricket! The only disappointing thing was the over rate which has been poor throughout the series so far, otherwise, it was an action-packed day abd much-needed after how dull the whole of the first Test was. Have to say Bangladesh will be the happier of the two and by a mile at the end of Day 1 and they have just the two men to thank, Das and Rahim. Absolutely stunning efforts from the two and they get a huge round of applause as they head into the pavilion.

Right then, two sessions done with both sides dominating a session each. With just one session remaining on the first day, both sides will be hoping to have the edge going into Day 2. Do join us for a riveting final session in a bit.

The pitch did look a good one for batting and that is what we can see in the post-Lunch session. This makes what Kasun Rajitha and Asitha Fernando did early in the day even more impressive. There is little to no help for the spinners, it is a day one pitch after all. The Sri Lankan spinners have lacked the intent and the consistency, they have either been too full or too short and they need to correct this, or else it could become a long and frustrating day for them. The only opportunity for a wicket came when Kamindu Mendis dropped Litton Das off Fernando's bowling and boy, he has punished them.

Session summary - 30 overs/86 runs/0 wickets. How the tables have turned! The post-Lunch session has been a stark contrast to the first session and the pitch seems to have eased out for the batters. From being 24/5 to 153/5, Mushfiqur Rahim and Litton Das have done a stellar job to get the hosts into a promising position. Both of them have not let the bad deliveries go unpunished and if they stay on for another session, Bangladesh will end the day certainly ahead of the game.

Brilliant start to the Test match and it's only the first session. The visitors are certainly in control of proceedings but if they allow Rahim and Das to stay on the crease for a long period of time, all the hard work done earlier in the day will go to waste. The hosts will want to keep batting for as long as possible as they haven't got any runs to play with at the moment. It will be exciting to see the approach of both sides after the break. Do join us in a bit for the post-Lunch session.

Mominul Haque won the toss and opted to bat which seemed like the thing to do but it was a disastrous start from the hosts in front of a good crowd in. Both openers were sent packing without troubling the scorers and the skipper too fell after hitting a couple of glorious boundaries. Before they could recover, Bangladesh were five down with just 24 runs on the board. Since then, Mushfiqur Rahim and Litton Das have done extremely well to stay on the crease and have added some crucial runs as well. Both of them though will need to bat for another session if the hosts are to get to a decent total.

A cracking opening session here on the first day of the second Test match. Sri Lanka lost the toss but came out all guns blazing with the ball. Kasun Rajitha and Asitha Fernando both found some swing with the new ball and then found the right length to hit as well. A wicket-each in their first over handed the visitors the upper hand. They built on it and picked up five wickets in between them inside the first seven overs to get a stranglehold on the first innings but it has eased out a bit now. They will now to come back fresh after the break and get rid of the last two recognized batters.

PITCH REPORT - Roshan Abeysinghe is pitchside. He says it looks like an excellent pitch and there is a bit of grass on it. Mentions that it is a bat-first pitch but having a close look at it shows that it is drier and as the game goes on, spinners will play a huge role and they will get some bounce as well.

Dimuth Karunaratne says that he wanted to bat first as well but looks like a good wicket and batting first will be crucial. Adds that if you lose the toss, you have to be prepared to do anything and the pacers were good last time around and hoepfully they give them a good start. Mentions that in the sub-continent spinners always play a big role. Informs that they have a couple of changes as well.

Mominul Haque says that they will have a bat first. Adds that the wicket looks good and later on it will get difficult so want to put a good total on board. Mentions that the batters have been good and hopefully they can continue the same. Informs that Mosaddek in for Nayeem and Ebadot comes in for Shoriful.

TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and they will have a BAT first.

Sri Lanka surprised a lot of people with their display in the first Test. Angelo Mathews agonizingly got out for a brilliant 199 before their pacers bowled their heart out on a dead track. Kasun Rajitha and Asitha Fernando did get wickets too but had to bowl long spells in the heat. Surprisingly their spinners did underwhelm a bit and Dimuth Karunaratne will be hoping that they come to the party in Mirpur and make good use of the slightly more spin-friendly conditions.

The hosts batted pretty well in the first game with experienced players like Tamim Iqbal and Mushfiqur Rahim both scoring centuries but what's worrying for them is the form of their skipper Mominul Haque. The pitch at Chattogram didn't offer anything to the bowlers and the Bangladeshi bowlers toiled hard but it was Nayeem Hasan who took a six-wicket haul in the first innings. Nayeem along with Shoriful Islam has been ruled out of the second Test which could be a big blow to the hosts' chances of winning as Mirpur does offer much more to the spinners.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second and final Test match between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka at the Shere Bangla National Stadium in Mirpur. A draw in the first Test means it is all to play for in the second. The team which wins this takes the series. Let us hope the wicket here in Dhaka has a lot more on offer for the bowlers and we get an even contest between bat and ball. Toss and teams in a bit…
